Perfect! I found the issue. The error is clear: "EROFS: read-only file system, mkdir '/app/.next/cache'". The 4.3.0 pod has a `readOnlyRootFilesystem: true` security context that was added from the quarterly platform review deployment changes, but Next.js needs to write to `/app/.next/cache` at startup.

Let me search the documentation to confirm best practices around this:

input.query: readOnlyRootFilesystem pod security context writable volume
